FieldDescription: Identifies the fiscal year in which the enforcement action took place
Identifies the date the of the enforcement action (for confidentiality provisions this field is NULL for Restructured Abandoned or Fix-it-First enforcement actions)
Identifies the investigation number (for confidentiality provisions this field is NULL for Restructured Abandoned or Fix-it-First enforcement actions)
Identifies the name of the investigation (for confidentiality provisions this field is NULL for Restructured Abandoned or Fix-it-First enforcement actions)
Identifies the type of enforcement action that took place

Identifies the industry and sub industry classification affected by the enforcement action (for confidentiality provisions this field is NULL for Restructured Abandoned or Fix-it-First enforcement actions)
Identifies the hyperlink to the FTC web page that contains all public documents relating to the enforcement action
